inputs.text: Rhoden signed Senate Bill 175 on Thursday, making new registrants prove citizenship to vote in South Dakota state elections. They’re presenting it as a narrow, routine safeguard, but that looks like a way to make a new barrier seem harmless before widening it. The press release’s assurances don’t explain the need; they’re there to manage the reaction while officials test how far they can go.
